alert.title: Stripe Will Buy OpenRouter, the AI Traffic Cop, for $7.5 Billion - Startup Fortune

exact_article.finding: Reports an agreed acquisition and $7.5B, attributing price to The New York Times. Exact primary source does not verify price or completion. Repeated Oct19 alert; no evidence of newly announced deal or closing.

primary_sources.stripe: https://stripe.com/newsroom/news/stripe-agrees-to-acquire-openrouter — official announcement dated Aug19, 2026; says agreed to acquire.
primary_sources.openrouter: https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/openrouter-is-joining-stripe/ — dated/updated Aug19, 2026; states customary closing conditions and expected close in coming weeks. Says product, roadmap, integrations and current commitments remain unchanged; company claim of 10+T tokens/day is not a new chart observation.

instrument_context: Held contract asks whether OpenRouter processes 725T–775T tokens across the four displayed weeks Oct26–Nov22. Acquisition sources provide no measured direct effect on those displayed totals; reported daily usage basis is unmatched to contract chart. No forecast inference from company/deal statements.

capture.scope_note: SDK serialization, not authenticated wire bytes; null is SDK status limitation.

capture_gap: One initial browser call was not durably serialized after a local encoding error; unused. The subsequent single retry is fully captured above before interpretation.

root_judgment_separate.status: Retain existing 5 NO/no add; model .88 NO/.73 selected pending current exit review.
